answer: A concrete approach: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The tide of work and the lagoon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a zephyr to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
